answer: A concrete defense is timber-marked island residency. Each identity registers on one island and receives a timber marker sealed to that island's epoch state; the marker must be re-stamped every epoch against fresh yarrow randomness, so a stamp minted last round is void. An identity that stops re-stamping loses standing, and clones clustered on one island all draw from the same stamp pool, which the ledger caps per island. A thousand clones must live on a thousand islands and re-stamp each round; an honest agent renews one marker.
